evidence.fact: Couloir to saddle, traverse west on class 3, snow face on south slope, last 100 ft class 2-3.

facts.value: North slope toward Horton Lake

evidence.fact: The north slope toward Horton Lake is a relatively safe descent.

facts.value: Ice axe and crampons

evidence.fact: Gear: ice axe, crampons.

ca_east_couloir_variation.note: Bypasses the 4th class rock at the top of the East Couloir. No second publisher found (see ca_east_couloir).

facts.value: 3rd

evidence.fact: MP rates the East Face 3rd class.
Route type line: 1800 ft.

facts.value: From Kaweah Gap go cross-country south toward the east/northeast face

evidence.fact: From Kaweah Gap scramble cross-country south to the E/NE face.

facts.value: The east face is the easiest way up and down the peak (grassy ramp or broad bowl)

evidence.fact: Grassy ramp or broad East Face bowl; easiest way up and down the peak.
The east face is relatively gentle and offers the easiest routes to the summit.

ca_east_face_20.note: Wikipedia calls the main route a Class 2 scramble; MP says 3rd - grade left single-source. Peak FA July 15 1926 (Farquhar and Eagle Scouts) not tied to this route on the page.

ca_east_face_left_side.skip_reason: Opened Wikipedia Whaleback_(California) (FA Aug 5 1936 Pridham and van Loben Sels; easiest route class 3; no route description). Mountain Project East Face Left pages 123693109 and 105827735 are Wind River Range routes, not this peak. SummitPost whaleback 403. No page describes the East Face, Left Side.
